# Aptelle

> Aptelle helps you find the right size in any brand before you buy, powered by your body profile and real fit data.

Aptelle is a pre-launch fit-intelligence platform for online clothing. It is being built to recommend the clothing size most likely to fit across different brands using a personalized body profile, the sizes you already wear, fit preferences and real fit outcomes from similar shoppers. Recommendations are designed to include a confidence score.

## What Aptelle does
- Plans to build a fit profile from your body and the sizes you already own
- Plans to map how brands fit through a cross-brand fit graph
- Plans to recommend a size in a new brand with a confidence score

## Status
- Pre-launch. Waitlist open at https://aptelle.com/
- No live product access, pricing or feature guarantee is currently published.
